title: 10 Iranian Fishermen Released by UAE in Sign of Thawing Ties
text:
10 Iranian Fishermen Released by UAE in Sign of Thawing Ties"

"🔆🔅BANDAR ABBAS, Sept. 13 — The release of 10 Iranian fishermen detained in the United Arab Emirates marks the first direct interaction between Tehran and Abu Dhabi following recent regional tensions, and appears to signal the beginning of a different phase in diplomatic engagement between the two countries."

"SOT1, Mohammad Soleimani, Head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Office in Hormozgan province (Farsi)-(00:03 - 00:47): "It was around early August when the families and the Bandar Lengeh governor's office informed us and requested that we inquire about the disappearance of these dear individuals. Based on previous experience and cases, we notified Iran's missions in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, and they prepared a memorandum that was submitted to the Emirati government. Fortunately, it happened very quickly; about two weeks ago, they provided us with the names of 10 people who are in an Abu Dhabi prison and will be released soon.""

"SOT2, Mohammad Soleimani, Head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Office in Hormozgan province (Farsi)-(00:54 - 01:21): "Our consulate in Dubai arranged tickets for them to arrive in Bandar Abbas on September 7, but unfortunately, due to problems on the part of the UAE government, they did not agree and the flight was canceled. However, a flight was arranged from Dubai to Tehran yesterday and they arrived in Tehran, and they will arrive in Bandar Abbas today.""

"SOT3, Mohammad Soleimani, Head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Office in Hormozgan province (Farsi)-(01:35 - 01:55): "We inquired about 13 people in total, but the UAE government reported 10 to us; they said three are not there. We are still following up with Qatar, Oman, and other places they might be connected to, and as soon as we receive any notification or their status becomes clear, we will inform their loved ones.
